name: code-block
title: Code block
description: Snippet surface with an optional filename header and a copy-to-clipboard button.

variants.name: labeled
variants.description: Header bar with a filename label and the copy button; omit data-variant.

variants.name: bare
variants.description: No header; the copy button floats top-right via `data-variant="bare"`.

docs: Wrap a `<pre data-slot="code">` in `.uif-code-block`; escape HTML entities in the snippet. The labeled variant (default) shows a `data-slot="label"` filename beside the copy button; `data-variant="bare"` drops the header and floats the button top-right. The script copies the snippet's text and flashes "Copied!" on the button.
